pages.text: Deep in the stone of Hellas lies orichalcum, the red gold of Atlantis. It needs an iron pickaxe; smelt the raw metal into ingots. Orichalcum gear is stronger than iron and takes enchantments well.
Higher in the mountains you find Hephaestus coal from the god's forges under the earth. In a furnace it burns twice as long as ordinary coal.
